classification: Finite laboratory simulation holdout selected without R23 candidate output; not a safety qualification, hidden production test, hardware certificate, or original course demo.
selection: Fixed post-detachment and transfer interpolation points, borderline signed diagonals, offsets, and mechanical perturbations before any R23 candidate was selected or executed.

contact_evidence.interpretation: Contact is measured from the physical tool-force trace. Failure to materialize the minimum makes the cohort inadequate rather than silently claiming preservation.

qualification.scoped_regression_floor: Preserve every strict R22 slot within 5 ms; zero candidate false rises, duplicate in-window rises, new tool prealarm, lost R22 tool detection, or stuck tail.
qualification.scoped_detection: Exactly one attributable candidate rising edge with a 24 ms quiet prefix for every isolated and both-impulse slot.
qualification.positive_gain: Report candidate strict slots where R22 is not strict separately; no minimum gain is required and gains do not convert this simulation into safety evidence.

gates: candidate and complete transitive frozen model locked before plan detail disclosure or holdout execution
all protocol and candidate pins stable before and after execution
exact 6000-sample finite traces and one-to-one episode accounting
immutable R22 signed native, second, committed, and stock scalar force arithmetic
force-free sensed prefix exact and causal fields exact through each first nonzero force tick
physical traces bit-exact across arms within each twin
candidate has zero unmatched false rise and zero duplicate rise in every event slot
candidate preserves each strict R22 event within 5 ms
candidate has one quiet attributable rise per intended real impulse
no new tool prealarm, lost R22 real-contact detection, or stuck tail
both independent mechanical variants cause an observed physical change
no thresholds, cohort, scoring, mechanics, sources, or physics change after outcomes
